scope: Shared measured TPG module comparison, 2x2 graph-priority and conservative-low-objective factorial; not an independent MAPPO system reproduction
low_control: All four learning arms share bounded command alternatives: norm of residual <=0.2 when nominal is admissible, otherwise exact old hold/escape; masks and joint measured projection unchanged. Nominal prior gives probability 0.5 when all 9 actions are valid.
innovation_hypothesis: Event graph priority plus risk-weighted KL to measured reference may retain useful navigation while learning limited corrections. Adaptation of known residual RL, PPO and reference regularization; no algorithmic novelty or superiority is yet established.
anchor: Low objective adds 0.05*(1+2*max(clipped track age/0.3, measured route ambiguity))*KL(policy||fixed nominal-biased candidate reference). Training only; both use the same greedy deployment.
shared_mechanics: Common safety reward, independent actor/critic gradient clipping, nominal prior, residual action bound, observations, event triggers, measured assignments and projection; high learning remains event-triggered with no mandatory 1 s reassignment.
runtime: Same isolated generic NumPy as EXP0054/55; EXP0055 had one unrepaired SIGSEGV. New source/protocol, every job attempted once, fresh full-duration identity and training admission. Any failure blocks ranking; no successful replacement of a crashed row.
selection: All 3 seeds from scratch, only fixed final 32768 checkpoint, complete 120-row evaluation matrix including classical TPG, balanced_1s and N1. Same eight previously used development scenes, never independent confirmation. Stop ranking on any job, hash or safety-score audit failure.
low_level_learning_evidence: Record both chosen alternative counts and actual requested command deviation; altered high scheduling alone is not evidence of learned low benefit.
claims: No physical magnetic safety guarantee, no convergence/generalization proof, no experiment selection or tuning on unopened confirmation pools. Radius is in normalized command units, not millimeters. Bounding pre-projection actions is not a bound on executed trajectories.
